label: champ_0030_rival_02
text: Just had to tell you—my Pokémon are learning\nsome pretty cool new moves! Be ready![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0030_rival_03
text: How’d it go at the Gym, by the way?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0030_rival_04a
text: Yesss! Hah haaa! I mean, it was obvious you were\ngonna pass, but congrats![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0030_rival_04b
text: Pfft! Sure, you big joker! I bet you walked out\nwith a badge, didn’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0030_rival_05
text: I’m so glad I encouraged you to take on the\nGyms. Nice job, past me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0030_rival_06
text:
I’m training hard too, by the way—day and night!
Going all over the place to boot!\c
Thank goodness we’ve got the map app. It helps
a ton with figuring out where to go next—
especially in a huge place like Paldea!\c
After all, the path to getting stronger usually has
some strange stops and detours!\c
Hm. Speaking of going strange places, I wonder
what Arven’s up to...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0030_rival_07
text: Anyway, catch you later! I hope you know I’m\ngonna want a battle if we run into each other![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
